findings.status: new (completes R21-MEC-01, whose list was also short)
findings.title: ORDERING 8.2's per-terminal hand-solder keep-off list leaves out four bottom parts that sit inside its own 1.76-2.17 mm range

evidence.file: docs/ORDERING.md section 8.2 'Hand-solder the eight DB125 bodies' bullet; m3_design/assembly_review/m3.kicad_pcb
evidence.reference: J410, J420, J9 and their bottom-side neighbours
evidence.method: B.Cu effective pad polygons, edge to edge, every bottom SMD pad against every DB125 THT pad (probe keepoff.py)

findings.impact: An assembler working from the list keeps the iron off the named parts but not off C410, C420, R102 or C431, which are as close as the listed ones (C431 is the 1210 bulk capacitor the plate model already flags as the tightest to the sled). Risk is a disturbed or bridged joint found at first-article inspection; no fire or function hazard. Documentation defect.
findings.concrete_fix: Docs only: in ORDERING 8.2, add C410 to J410's entry, C420 to J420's, and R102 and C431 to J9's; or replace the list with 'every bottom part within 2.5 mm of a DB125 hole', followed by the full table above. Optionally add a fit_check/check_r10 test that rebuilds the list from the board, so it cannot go stale.

rejected_or_closed_candidates: Tallest parts: top C84 10.8 mm (x 23.25-31.75, near the axis; large bore margin), DB125 bodies 8.9 mm with 2.98 mm bore margin, J3 0.886 mm margin (tightest, unchanged). Bottom: L1 3.02 mm below the bottom face (0.984 mm to a 1 mm plate on 4 mm standoffs), then the 2.7 mm 1210 capacitors C431 / C411 / C421 / C406 / C82 / C405. Nothing moved near any of them.

Supports: nearest top exposed pad LED2.2 3.808 mm from (4,44.3) (3.8 mm gate); nearest bottom obstacle C32.2 4.536 mm (3.5 mm minimum). Nylon or insulated hardware at all five remains required. R81 / C87 are more than 15 mm from every support.

DB125 wire room: 5.00-5.60 mm on all eight terminals (5.003 nominal) against the 4.95 mm floor. Screwdriver access is from above the bodies with the board out of the bore; unchanged and recorded as physically unverified.
microSD J430 B(24,24.3): unchanged; closed envelope fits (z -1.6 to -3.7). The rule to open the hinge only with the PCB unbolted from the sled stands (ORDERING 8.4).

U5 venting: U5 B(10.6,49.1) unchanged, its port facing the sled across a 2.9 mm allocation at 4 mm standoffs; REQUIREMENTS 'Static ports' asks for a vented bay and opaque foam. The vehicle's static-port sizing for Mach 1.9 is vehicle-level and outside the board scope.

Flight loads: boost 28-37 g and recovery shock are axial, in the board plane, and act as shear on C84, the DB125 bodies, J3 and LS120. These are covered by the open P3 staking and 5 x 100 g retention qualification. The transverse 100 g plate case gives the 0.261 mm C431 gap already disclosed. Nothing in this fix pass changes either.
R81 / C87 over U9: different faces, no shared courtyard; bottom-first reflow is unaffected.
